scene: The candy tracks end at a bustling transit dock across the frozen pond.
picture: Side-view pixel art of an icy transit terminal on a snowy ground line. On the far left, a hillside chairlift dangles ready at a wooden ramp. To the left, the boy in an orange vest, white scarf, and back kite stands facing forward. In the centre sits a crimson sleigh tram. On the far right, a glass-bottomed boat floats in thawed water.
